name: souroldgeezer-tabletop
description: Plugins by Sour Old Geezer for tabletop roleplaying simulation: seeded, deterministic rules engines served over a local HTTP API, with the commands and skills that drive them.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-fivee-sim
plugins.description: 5E-compatible combat simulation over a single seeded rules kernel. Stateful encounters the engine owns and the assistant narrates, plus Monte Carlo damage and win-rate analytics replayed through the same stepper, so the statistics can never drift from the rules live play uses. Covers weapon attacks, movement and reactions, conditions, and a curated spell set with saves, areas, and concentration.
